# Test fixtures

Small excerpts of real public data, trimmed for tests. Do not edit by hand.

- `openbilanci_spese_genova_2019.json`: two top-level nodes (and three
  descendants) of Genova's 2019 harmonised expenditure accounts, downloaded
  from openbilanci.it on 2026-10-01. Source: Ministry of the Interior, Finanza
  Locale, via OpenBilanci (Fondazione Openpolis, Depp Srl). Licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
- `istat_sample.csv`: the header and six rows of ISTAT's "Elenco comuni
  italiani", downloaded from www.istat.it on 2026-10-01, Latin-1 as published.
